request.description: Creates a DRAFT order for an existing customer with one or more items. The server validates the customer and products, rejects duplicate product IDs within the request, captures current product prices, and calculates the order total. Products must be active. Inventory is not deducted or reserved during draft creation.

request.description: Updates the order status according to permitted transitions: DRAFT to CONFIRMED or CANCELLED; CONFIRMED to FULFILLED or CANCELLED. Confirmation requires all products to be active and sufficient stock for every order item. Stock deduction and status change occur atomically. If confirmation fails, the order remains DRAFT and stock remains unchanged. Cancelling a DRAFT order does not change stock. Cancelling a CONFIRMED order restores the previously deducted stock transactionally. FULFILLED and CANCELLED are terminal states.

item.name: Add an item to an order

request.description: Adds an item to an existing DRAFT order. The order and product must exist, the product must be active, and the quantity must be positive. The server captures the current product price and recalculates the order total. Inventory is not deducted during draft modification.

item.name: Update an item quantity in an order

request.description: Updates the quantity of an existing item in a DRAFT order. The item must belong to the specified order, and the new quantity must be positive. The original unit price is preserved, and the order total is recalculated. Inventory is not changed.
